## Page 7

Oil & Gas
Source : IEA, EIA and StatistaOil & Gas Demand
Global oil demand is expected to increase from around 104 
mb/d in 2025 to about 105 mb/d in 2026, confirming 
continued growth. However, demand is projected to rise only 
modestly to roughly 106 –107 mb/d by 2030, indicating a 
gradual transition toward a lower -growth, plateau phase.
Natural Gas Demand
Global natural gas demand is expected to rebound 
from around 4.26 tcm in 2025 to roughly 4.34 tcm in 
2026, supported by new LNG supply, and is 
projected to continue growing to about 4.5 tcm by 
2030, indicating steady structural growth.
Oil & Gas Capex
Global oil and gas capex is expected to ease slightly 
from 2025 levels in 2026, reflecting stronger capital 
discipline, and is projected to remain broadly stable 
through 2030, indicating a structural investment 
plateau rather than a new investment super -cycle.
